SELECT * FROM ( SELECT hbma.* , hbma.country_n||hbma.province_n||hbma.city_n ||hbma.district_n||hbma.address address_detail
FROM ( SELECT ma.address_id, ma.bp_id, ma.address_type, (select v.meaning from sys_code_value_b_v v where v.code = 'FND.BP_ADDRESS_TYPE' and v.code_value = ma.address_type) as address_type_n, ma.country_id, ( SELECT c.country_name FROM fnd_country c WHERE c.country = ma.country_id ) AS country_id_n, ma.province_id, ( SELECT p.description FROM fnd_province p WHERE p.province = ma.province_id ) AS province_id_n, ma.city_id, ( SELECT c.description FROM fnd_city c WHERE c.city = ma.city_id ) AS city_id_n, ma.district_id, ( SELECT d.description FROM fnd_district d WHERE d.district = ma.district_id ) AS district_id_n, ma.country, ma.province, ma.city, ma.district, (select c.country_name from fnd_country c where c.country = ma.country) as country_n, (select p.description from fnd_province p where p.province = ma.province) as province_n, (select c.description from fnd_city c where c.city = ma.city) as city_n, (select d.description from fnd_district d where d.district = ma.district) as district_n, ma.region, (select v.meaning from sys_code_value_b_v v where v.code = 'FND_ADDR_REGIDN' and v.code_value = ma.region) as region_n, ma.street, ma.address, ma.zipcode, ma.contact_person, ma.position, ma.phone, ma.fax, ma.cell_phone, ma.email, ma.enabled_flag, ma.is_mail_invoice_address, ma.remark, (select wm_concat(t.contract_name) from (select t.CONTRACT_name from FCT_PROJECT t where t.project_id in (select fb.PROJECT_ID from FCT_PROJECT_bp fb where fb.ADDRESS_ID in (select hd.ADDRESS_ID from hls_bp_master_address hd where hd.bp_id= #{bpId,jdbcType=BIGINT}) ) and t.CONTRACT_STATUS not in('END','CANCEL') and t.DATA_TYPE='NORMAL' union select t.CONTRACT_name from prj_PROJECT t where t.project_id in (select fb.PROJECT_ID from PRJ_PROJECT_BP fb where fb.ADDRESS_ID in (select hd.ADDRESS_ID from hls_bp_master_address hd where hd.bp_id= #{bpId,jdbcType=BIGINT}) ) and t.CONTRACT_STATUS not in('END','CANCEL') and t.DATA_TYPE='NORMAL') t)address_info
FROM hls_bp_master_address ma where ma.bp_id = #{bpId,jdbcType=BIGINT} ) hbma ) ads where 1=1
and ads.address_detail LIKE concat('%',concat(#{addressDetail},'%') )

SELECT hbma.*, ( SELECT v.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v.code = 'FND.BP_ADDRESS_TYPE' AND v.code_value = hbma.address_type ) AS address_type_n, ( SELECT c.country_name FROM fnd_country c WHERE c.country = hbma.country_id ) AS country_id_n, ( SELECT p.description FROM fnd_province p WHERE p.province = hbma.province_id ) AS province_id_n, ( SELECT c.description FROM fnd_city c WHERE c.city = hbma.city_id ) AS city_id_n, ( SELECT d.description FROM fnd_district d WHERE d.district = hbma.district_id ) AS district_id_n, ( CASE
WHEN hbma.DISTRICT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN ( SELECT ZIPCODE FROM FND_DISTRICT fd WHERE hbma.DISTRICT_ID = fd.DISTRICT ) WHEN hbma.CITY_ID IS NOT NULL THEN ( SELECT ZIPCODE FROM FND_CITY fc WHERE hbma.CITY_ID = fc.CITY ) END ) AS POSTCODE FROM hls_bp_master_address hbma where hbma.bp_id = #{bpId}
